svg.title: Semcod refactoring roadmap — 9 phases from cleanup to marketplace
svg.desc: Flowchart showing 30 tasks across 9 phases with dependencies and metrics targets

g.text: Delete dead files + server_old.py · 1h · risk: none
6h · done when: all CC < 10, e2e pass

svg.text: done: pytest 330 tests pass, no file > 400L

g.text: 4h · blocked by Phase 3 · target: 0 func CC ≥ 15
Pre-commit hook + CI gate · no new file >400L · CC delta <0.2
20h · scan diff + auto-PR + billing + scheduled scans

svg.text: done: Stripe checkout works, auto-PR creates branch+PR, alerts fire

g.text: 40h · ticket → LLM → PR → deploy · 1 month free trial
www: CC̄≤2.0 · redsl: CC̄≤3.0 · 0 god modules
